mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.work_id, c.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, c.parent_id, parent.author_id AS reply_to_author_id, parent_user.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, CASE WHEN c.status = 'deleted' THEN '' ELSE c.content END AS content, CASE WHEN c.status = 'deleted' THEN NULL ELSE c.image_url END AS image_url, (c.author_id = #{userId}) AS mine, (c.status = 'deleted') AS deleted, c.created_at FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id LEFT JOIN comments parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id LEFT JOIN users parent_user ON parent_user.id = parent.author_id WHERE c.work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT id, work_id, author_id, parent_id, content, image_url, status, created_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (work_id, author_id, parent_id, content, image_url, status, created_at) VALUES (#{workId}, #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, 'active', #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET status = 'deleted', content = '', image_url = NULL, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND status = 'active'
